title: Photo of Kid Thomas' band and the WPA band at the boys' home
summary: They look at a c. 1955 photo of Kid Thomas' band, then a WPA band photo where Paul sits behind Willie Humphrey with his soprano sax; the band played at the boys' home on Wednesdays.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear
